gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (Law Enforcement Center Fund column) prints three other-financing rows: Premium from sale of bonds 1,051,759, Issuance costs from sale of bonds (264,843) and Proceeds from sale of bonds 17,505,000 (Total other financing sources 18,291,916); the JSON keeps 17,505,000 as debt_proceeds and 1,051,759 - 264,843 = 786,916 as other_financing. The only schedule for that fund, the Law Enforcement Center Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p15), prints one net line 'Proceeds from sale of bonds' 18,291,916 under RECEIPTS, which is detail line 'Proceeds from sale of bonds' 18,291,916 (already in detail[]). 18,291,916 - 17,505,000 = 786,916 = the gap = premium 1,051,759 - issuance costs 264,843. The schedule prints the bond money net in one row, so it cannot be split without a derived figure, and adding the p5 premium / issuance-cost rows would count that money twice. No change. Other Governmental Funds column transfers (in 701,798 / out (1,036,680), p5) are all in detail (7,000 + 3,599 + 339,027 + 352,172; 7,000 + 1,003,599 + 26,081); no other printed other-financing row is missing and no transfer line is mislabelled.
